notes: Submitted buy/sell/hold is parsed from response_text because rejected steps use action_family=invalid.

The submitted_action_counts denominator is applied environment requests; all_generated_response_action_counts separately includes incomplete/unparseable model responses. All failed paths and retries are retained.
Target weights describe submitted single-symbol orders, not total portfolio exposure.

Fill notional, observed_fees_total and observed_sum_turnover describe actual execution, including truncated failed paths. Full-trajectory mean cost/turnover remains NA if any path failed; no successful-subset mean is substituted.
Symbols are normalized with strip().upper() for economic AAPL counts, matching the environment; raw buy symbol strings are also retained.
Simple response JSON-shape parser counts are descriptive; recorded_environment_error_categories uses the actual environment error and is authoritative for rejection class.
No new generation, model load, source replay, or financial reward changes.
